postTitle: Windfalls: Bonuses, Inheritances, and Sale Proceeds
topic: Many people park a windfall before deciding anything

assumptions.notes: Blog: if savings pay 4% a year, €50,000 parked for 90 days earns about €500 of interest (50,000 x 0.04 x 90/365 = €493). Before tax. Parking periods from the blog: regular windfall about 30 days; larger irregular 60 to 90; emotionally loaded 90 minimum. Within deposit insurance limits.

bands.label: Deploy
items: All at once or in steps

bandStory.disclosure: Illustrative. 4% before tax; rates and deposit protection vary by country.

hookVariants.narration: Fifty thousand euros just landed. What do many people do first? They park it, often ninety days or more for an inheritance.

beats.narration: Many people park it in a named savings account. At four percent, it earns about five hundred in ninety days.
That buys time to plan, deploy, and check spending after.
beats.subtext: The decision comes after the emotion

beats.narration: A common practice: thirty days for a bonus, sixty to ninety for a sale, ninety or more for an inheritance.

anchor.title: The parking period
anchor.footnote: A common practice, not a rule.
